Check a QWAdata object

Source: R/QWAdata.R
check_QWAdata.Rd

Checks a QWAdata object before submission. Aborts if the object is not a valid QWAdata (missing, mistyped or NA keys, duplicate (image, year) in $rings). Warns (or, with strict = TRUE, aborts) on:

  • values violating the cells or rings schema (types, ranges, allowed values);

  • duplicate cell keys (image, year, xpix, ypix), the key of the cells in TRIA;

  • dating problems: gaps and future years;

  • missing values in the automatic ring flags (see complete_flags());

  • images only in $cells or only in $rings, and images without ring measurements (no mrw > 0; check the output files and re-read them with update_QWAdata());

  • years with cells but without a rings row, and cno not matching the number of cells (re-run complete_QWAdata()).

Usage

check_QWAdata(x, strict = FALSE, exclude_mode = NULL)

Arguments

x

A QWAdata object.

strict

If TRUE, abort on the first issue instead of warning.

exclude_mode

Deprecated and ignored.

Value

TRUE if no issue was found, FALSE otherwise (invisibly).

Details

Also informs about missing optional columns, extra columns (kept, but not imported into TRIA by default) and images without CWT estimates.

See also

QWAdata(), complete_QWAdata(), check_consistency()
